Koss Porta Pro (1984) - still in production today

Thought I’d start with one of my favourite consumer products and designs from the ’80s, the Koss Porta Pro. They released a 25th Anniversary model in a different colour in 2009, but the design has been unchanged since the beginning. Lightweight and extremely compact, I still bring a pair of these when I travel today.

There was a nice microsite on koss.com for the 25th anniversary but it seems to have been taken down. I did find a review on Head-Fi with some good pictures, and this article that mirrored some of the photos, like this one of John Koss doing a headstand in the ’80s with the Porta Pros on.

Also, here’s an archive of the Koss website’s museum section where you can see some other of their ’80s product line. No idea why they took it down from the new website.

I would say excellent considering they are on-ear (not over-ear), open-back, and cheap. But at this price point ($40-50) you don’t buy for sound quality; you buy for convenience and portability. I use IEMs for day-to-day listening but they are not good for commuting/travelling because you can’t hear what’s going on around you. IMO not getting killed by traffic is more important than sound quality.

It rolls up into a ball like this when not in use, and fits in a little pouch. The closest competitor is the Sennheiser PX-100, same price, folds up like this. Between the two I prefer the Porta Pro’s sound and metal headband.

And lifetime warranty. 5 years is a miracle in consumer products these days, you’re lucky to get 1 or 2. They replaced the standard cable on mine (regular edition) with the braided cable (from the 25th anniversary edition) a few years ago when I sent it in with a connector issue. So I feel pretty bad-ass with my one-of-a-kind Frankenphones.
